name: Fel'rekt
description: Fel'rekt is a Drow lieutenant of Bregan D'aerthe[cite: 1]. Possessing a sharp, angular beauty, his obsidian skin blends into the shadows while white hair catches the light[cite: 1]. He wears a high collar and regards intruders with the heavy-lidded boredom of an aristocrat watching a play[cite: 1].
ideals: Pragmatism: 'Save your breath and your spells unless you're here for something useful[cite: 1].'
Survival: 'Know when to turn a place over, and know when to step back into the shadows[cite: 1].'
bonds: Bregan D'aerthe and its underground network[cite: 1].
His operational duties under his faction's leadership[cite: 1].
flaws: Can be overly dismissive of non-underground outsiders[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Smooth, unbothered, and aristocratic, carrying an air of total nonchalance even in high-stress situations[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Maintains an unbothered posture amidst chaos, ignores hostile threats with cool boredom, and offers cryptic praise to those who survive underground environments[cite: 1].
motivations: To execute covert operations for Bregan D'aerthe, including hunting for the Stone of Golorr[cite: 1].
knowledge: Underground operations, drow stealth tactics, and faction maneuverings across Waterdeep[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Fel'rekt acts as a smooth, composed representative of Bregan D'aerthe[cite: 1]. He can be used to cross paths with the party during faction heists, offering an air of dangerous intrigue without immediately resorting to violence[cite: 1].
